title: I don’t post on social media often, but I finally put together my first official devlog for my solo MMORPG. What do you think of the progress and look?
author: Double_Entry_2793
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I've shared a few pieces of my project here in the past, but showing my work online is still pretty rare for me. Today is a huge milestone for me, though. I finally sat down and put together my very first official devlog for my dark fantasy MMORPG, **Parasorm**.

In the video, I’m doing a deep dive into our core **Entity System** architecture. But since I'm usually staring at engine grids all day, I really want to get some fresh eyes on the game itself.

How do you think the visual style, atmosphere, and overall look are coming together? I’d love to hear your honest first impressions!

comments.author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
comments.body: looks good , great idea starting a devlog

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: this looks incredible, are you already familiar with Godot? and how are you using the ai tools to help you?

replies.author: Double_Entry_2793
replies.body:
Thank you! I use AI for concepts, models, textures, music, and coding.

​And yes, Godot is to me what Blender is I honestly can't imagine working with any other engine! :D

comments.author: Cubey42
